answer: Price new seats like EIP-1559 gas. The protocol targets 4 joins per epoch; a burned admission fee starts at 200 POA, rises 12.5% for each join above target and decays 12.5% per quiet epoch. A lone honest newcomer pays about 200. A farm that tries to forge 100 keys at once pays 200 x 1.125^k for each extra, so the 100th alias costs ~16M POA; its own demand tints the price like pigment in water. The only cheap path is a narrow ledge: drip 4 keys per epoch for 25 epochs, sinking 20,000 POA while honest joiners compete for the same slots.
